anthropic-claude-sonnet-4.5.name: Claude 4.5 Sonnet
anthropic-claude-sonnet-4.5.description: Anthropic’s balanced, general-purpose Claude model with strong reasoning, coding, and instruction-following. Good default for production chat, agents, and RAG.

pricing.notes: Fill with current vendor pricing; varies by region and plan.

anthropic-claude-haiku-4.5.name: Claude 4.5 Haiku
anthropic-claude-haiku-4.5.description: Fast, lightweight Claude variant optimized for low-latency, high-throughput tasks and tool use where cost and speed matter.

pricing.notes: Typically lower-cost than Sonnet; confirm current rates.

google-gemini-3-flash-preview.name: Gemini 3 Flash Preview
google-gemini-3-flash-preview.description: High speed, high value thinking model designed for agentic workflows, multi-turn chat, and coding assistance. Near Pro level reasoning and tool use performance with lower latency. Supports 1M context, multimodal inputs (text, images, audio, video, PDFs), configurable thinking levels, structured output, and tool use.

pricing.notes: Preview model. Audio input at $1/M tokens. Supports context caching.

google-gemini-2.5-flash.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
google-gemini-2.5-flash.description: Speed-optimized Gemini model for rapid responses and streaming; suitable for chat, tools, and lightweight multimodal tasks.

pricing.notes: Flash tiers are usually lower-cost than Pro; verify with Google pricing.

google-gemini-2.5-pro.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
google-gemini-2.5-pro.description: Stronger reasoning and coding than Flash; suited for complex analysis, agents, and higher-quality generation.

pricing.notes: Pricing may differ for text vs multimodal usage; check vendor docs.

openai-gpt-5.name: Chat GPT 5
openai-gpt-5.description: OpenAI’s next-generation general model aimed at advanced reasoning, coding, and multimodal capabilities.

pricing.notes: Use official OpenAI pricing once available.

x-ai-grok-code-fast-1.name: Grok Code Fast
x-ai-grok-code-fast-1.description: xAI's fast, code-focused model optimized for low-latency code generation, completion, and refactoring.

pricing.notes: Confirm current xAI pricing for this tier.

x-ai-grok-4.1-fast-free.name: Grok 4.1 Fast (Free)
x-ai-grok-4.1-fast-free.description: xAI's best agentic tool calling model that shines in real-world use cases like customer support and deep research. 2M context window. Reasoning can be enabled/disabled using the reasoning_enabled parameter.

pricing.notes: Free tier model from xAI. Created Nov 19, 2025.

google-gemini-embedding-001.name: Gemini Embedding 001
google-gemini-embedding-001.description: Unified embedding model across science, legal, finance, and coding domains. Top performer on MTEB Multilingual leaderboard. Note: This is an embedding model, not for chat/completions.

pricing.notes: Embedding models return vectors, not text. Requires different API endpoint.
